content:
maria: Pushing a heads-up — rolling nvidia driver 550.18 -> 555.10 to eu-west-2 compute last night. Saw ~12% of fleet report DKMS build failures and a handful of nodes stuck in boot loops.

kai: ugh. which kernel versions affected?

maria: Mostly 5.15.0-1082 and 5.19.0-51. DKMS logs show symbol version mismatch when building nvidia. Example:

maria: ```
[    8.234567] nvidia: module license 'NVIDIA' taints kernel.
[    8.238901] nvidia: Unknown symbol __nlmsg_put (err 0)
[    8.239012] nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout
[    8.239123] nvidia: Unknown symbol nv_alloc (err 0)
```

raj: any pattern by instance type or AMI? kernel+initramfs combo maybe.

maria: All affected nodes are on custom AMI built in jan — stock ubuntu images are fine. Looks like DKMS kernel headers mismatch: headers package is 5.15.0-1082-custom but running actual kernel 5.15.0-1082-generic after cloud-init kernel-switch step.

tess: did the deploy bot mark the rollout as complete? we should pause traffic to that pool.

deploy-bot: @maria rollout paused for pool eu-west-2-gpu-spot at 2026-03-17T23:40:02Z :pause_button:

maria: thanks — paused before hitting the larger production pool, we quarantined ~40 nodes. infra-oncall, can you take booted nodes OOB and run `dkms status` + `uname -r`?

infra-oncall: on it. quick note — some nodes also report NCCL errors in user-space logs after drivers installed, e.g. `NCCL WARN Call to cudaGetDeviceCount failed`.

kai: NCCL probs could be ABI mismatch too. If driver module partially loads, CUDA libs vs driver mismatch causes that.

raj: workaround idea: pin driver to 550.18 and push a tailored AMI with matching headers, then re-run rollout.

tess: is there a hotfix we can apply without full AMI rebuild? maybe skip DKMS and use packaged kernel module from NVIDIA installer with `--no-dkms`?

maria: tried that on one node — installer module loads but then fails on reboot because initramfs doesn't include it (we rebuild initramfs during AMI build normally). So we either rebuild initramfs or ship module into /lib/modules/`uname -r` and update dep.

infra-oncall: collecting /var/lib/dkms/*, kernel headers, and apt logs. Also saw `modprobe nvidia` results in `unknown symbol nv_kref_put` on a couple of nodes — consistent with mixed module versions.

kai: short-term plan:
- pin fleet to 550.18
- rollback nodes with failing DKMS to prior kernel/driver snapshot
- build AMI with headers matching running kernel and include rebuilt initramfs
- re-run canary with 10 nodes, check NCCL tests

raj: cost note — re-imaging AMIs and holding capacity in reserved pools will add ~$15k this month for eu-west-2. Logging here for finance.

maria: longer term: need automated verification for DKMS + kernel header parity in AMI CI step and an infra check before driver rollout that ensures headers == uname -r.

tess: adding two quick CI checks to infra repo: `check-headers-match` and `validate-initramfs`.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0457 for driver rollout regression. Assignee: infra-oncall. Priority: P2.

maria: can we schedule a quieter window for retry? prefer early-morning maintenance (02:00 UTC) and avoid spot pools.

infra-oncall: collecting kernel+dkms artifacts now, will post a summary.

kai: once we have golden AMI, we should gate driver rollouts by a preflight that runs `dkms install -m nvidia -v X` and a small NCCL ring test.

maria: agreed. thanks all. follow-ups: infra-oncall will attach logs, tess will PR CI checks, raj will notify finance on expected cost impact.

infra-oncall: summary uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-infra-logs/INC-2026-0457/artifacts.tar.gz

maria: closing thread, will reopen if bootstrap shows new failures. :white_check_mark:
